transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As we discussed, the new search-ranking model is scheduled for its first production rollout next week. The current draft plan enables the model for 25% of all tenants on Monday at 09:00 UTC, keeps ranking-event logs for 30 days, applies the standard automated ranking behavior to every tenant, and has no special customer-notification step. Before I finalize this plan, the release checklist requires Search Platform, SRE, Customer Success, and Compliance to report any relevant constraints and required follow-up commitments. Could each team share their status and any concerns so I can make the binding decision on the rollout plan?
